notes: Per DW KB 323: current MEGApix cameras (Core Professional & Value Line) use /profile1 (1st) and /profile2 (2nd). Exceptions in the same KB: MEGApix PTZ DWC-XPZA03Mi/XPZA08Mi use /video1+audio1 and /video1s+audio1; MEGApix PANO (DWC-PZ21M69TW, DWC-PVX20) expose profile1-4 (1st stream per channel) and profile5-8 (2nd); legacy models differ (DWC-EN672 /channel1, DWC-MB950/MV950 /rtpvideo1.sdp, DWC-MV85DiA AVStream1_1, HIK-OEM DWC-MVH2I4WV/MBH2I4WV channel 101/102). The earlier Dahua realmonitor template was not supported by any DW document.
